questions.q: Which statement about the focus works is correct?
options: They are played in the exam and you answer questions about them
They are not used in the exam, but extracts relate to them
There is only one for the whole course
questions.why: The syllabus states focus works will not be used in the exam; extracts are related in style, structure or genre.

questions.q: A clarinet in B flat reads a written C. What sounds?
questions.why: B flat clarinets sound a major 2nd lower than written.

questions.q: A phrase ends on chord V and sounds unfinished. This is a(n)...
Explain how to identify the key of a printed extract. [3]
questions.model: Look at the key signature, then check for accidentals such as a raised seventh and at the final chord, to decide between the major key and its relative minor.
